author: westcott
title: The Gospel According to St. John: The Authorised Version with Introduction and Notes
edition: London: John Murray, 1892 ("Ninth thousand"), the separate edition reprinted from The Speaker's Commentary (1880); archive.org scan "gospelaccordingt00westuoft" (University of Toronto), djvu OCR text

rights.worldwide: to confirm: death dates of every author, translator and editor named (life + 70 years)

notes: None: every verse 1-18 has at least one entry. Not on CCEL (CCEL has only Westcott on Hebrews). The text is archive.org djvu OCR: the only changes are line breaks reflowed, hyphenated line ends joined, and running heads and page footers dropped (e.g. "New Test. — VOL. II." inside the "the Word was God" note). Greek: the OCR turns Westcott's Greek into Latin-letter garbage (e.g. "(Xoyof, Vulg. verbum ...)"). Per the brief, nothing was retyped. Passages heavy in Greek were avoided, and where a short parenthetical held OCR'd Greek it was dropped whole, without any marker. Some of those parentheticals also held a Vulgate gloss or a cross-reference, e.g. "(t^yjivaTo, Vulg. enarravit [disseruit, exposuit])", "(Qtov, not rov $eoi/)", "(riDNl non)" (Hebrew), "(8o|a)", "(rtdfa^fda)". In one note ("the Word was God") a whole sentence quoting Greek was replaced by " ...". The .pieces.json sidecar lists the verbatim fragments around every dropped parenthetical. OCR errors are kept verbatim and not corrected, notably the old-style figures read as letters ("i John i. 2" for 1 John, "(i) ... (a) ... (3)" for (1) (2) (3), "v. n" for v. 11, "Matt. xi.
